evidence.detail: rs/f/a$b preserves exactly NORMAL, WINTER, DARK_WINTER, HALLOWEEN and SUMMER. Every non-NORMAL value carries one fixed RGB color payload.

The live Client command parser maps exact commands winter, hween, summer, darkwinter/darkxmas onto the corresponding enum values, toggles the active rs/f/a.r value and persists the selection through ClientSettings.

The enum is consumed across FloorDefinition, NpcDefinition, ObjectDefinition, ObjectManager/region rendering and adjacent world-definition paths. These consumers recolor or replace world floors, NPC/object definitions and region presentation according to the active enum.
FloorDefinition directly reads the enum's integer payload as an RGB replacement color for eligible floor colors, while NORMAL bypasses the seasonal replacement.

ClientSettings persists this enum as the first component of ground_mode=<WorldTheme>.<secondary-seasonal-mode>; the active/default fields initialize to NORMAL and the configured override is omitted when it equals the default.

proposals.note: WorldTheme is fixed by the exact seasonal enum constants, direct winter/hween/summer/darkwinter command toggles, RGB theme payload and broad floor/NPC/object/region consumers. R153 deliberately does not name sibling rs/f/a$d, whose ItemDefinition-only seasonal override role remains narrower and less independently anchored. Confidence is 0.999.
